lines: You slip out the basement window.
The rain is deafening. You hear Deacon kicking in your front door.
You need to get to the Spillway House. The only place with answers.

w2.text: Deacon will track your phone's GPS. You need to spoof it.

g1.text: Open the Cloud and configure the GPS spoofer.

config.brief: Order the GPS waypoints to create a fake trail. Start at Diner, end at Spillway.

lines: Your phone's location now shows you heading towards the Diner.
In reality, you are sprinting through the flooded woods towards the Spillway.

w3.text: The Spillway house has a biometric lock. I managed to get Caleb's voice print before he vanished.

g2.text: Open the Calls app and match Caleb's voice.

config.brief: Adjust the pitch and speed to match Caleb's voice print.

lines: The door to the Spillway House clicks open.
Inside, it's pitch black. The smell of mildew and old paper.
You turn on your flashlight. The walls are covered in blueprints of the dam.

w4.text: Look at the blueprints. The dam wasn't built to hold the water. It was built to funnel it.

w5.text: Into the old silver mines beneath the town. The town is built on a hollow crust.

w6.text: If they blow the dam, the water rushes into the mines. The entire town of Hollowmere will collapse into a sinkhole.

lines: Mass murder. To cover up what? What is in those mines?
You find a locked safe in the floorboards. It requires a Sudoku sequence.

g3.text: Solve the Sudoku lock on the safe.

mg3.title: Safe Lock

config.brief: Solve the mini Sudoku puzzle to open the safe.

hints: Make sure no row, column, or block has duplicate numbers.

lines: Inside is a single ledger. The true history of Hollowmere.
Ardis's father didn't discover silver in the mines. He discovered something else.
